text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Joaquim Chissano told a ministerial delegation from the Common Market of Eastern and Southern Africa (Comesa) that Mozambique stood by its decision to suspend its participation in the trade grouping.
- South African helicopters have rescued nearly 600 flood victims in the Zambezi river valley in central Moxzambique since Saturday.
- The Mozambican parliament on Tuesday begins debating a bill regulating municipal elections due to be held in the second half of this year.
